thread:
maya: Hey team — GreyStone is ready to run a POC to swap out CompetitorX for Redwood. They care about prompt parity, streaming ordering, token accounting (billing deltas), and a short security questionnaire. POC target next Wed. Can we confirm what the shim work would look like and a rough POC cost?

trevor: Great. Need a short bulleted answer for the customer on timeline and a ballpark price for ~10M tokens/month. Also call out any data residency/legal blockers.

samir: I can own the adapter/shim. Quick Q: are they maintaining state on their side using a `session_id` + `session_state` blob? CompetitorX sends `session_state` back on every response which clients rehydrate.

maya: Yep, customer sample:

```json
POST /v1/complete
{
  "session_id": "abc123",
  "input": "Summarize this...",
  "stream": true
}
```

samir: Important notes: CompetitorX streaming frames include an explicit `done` object and a `session_state` in the final frame. Our streaming emits token deltas (no final `done` metadata by default) and stores KV cache server-side. This will change client reassembly. I recommend a small wrapper that: (1) re-emits `session_state` as a metadata envelope, (2) appends `done:true` as last event, and (3) preserves ordering. I can prototype in ~1 day.

rachel: From runtime side — we can add an `X-Redwood-Compat: competitorx-v1` header in POC to enable the shim behaviour. We'll surface `session_state` as `compat_session_state` in the response body so clients see the same fields. Implementation ETA: 2 dev days + 0.5 day QA. Note: tokenization differences will still cause token_count variance (~2-5% typical) because of different tokenizers/byte-pair merges; this affects billing numbers.

evan: Pricing quick math for hosted POC: list price ~$0.0008 per token gen (example), 10M tokens -> $8,000/mo. For a POC we can do a 15% temporary credit -> ~$6,800/mo. If they want Dedicated reserved, baseline commit would be separate (we can provide options).

sec-bot: Security checklist link: https://redwood-internal/sec-templates/generics-sq (customer requires SOC2 + customer-managed KMS). GreyStone explicitly asked for KMS BYOK and EU data residency.

maya: They also called out webhook retry semantics — CompetitorX is at-least-once and dedupes with `request_id`. What is Redwood's webhook behaviour?

samir: Redwood webhooks are at-least-once with `X-Idempotency-Key` support. For strict parity we should add `request_id` echo header in shim and document recommended dedupe logic.

rachel: On residency — we support Private (VPC/on-prem) and hosted in eu-west-1. Private deployment with customer-managed KMS will satisfy their residency and BYOK asks, but setup adds ~3-4 weeks and an enterprise SOW. For the POC we can spin up a staging instance in eu-west-1 (hosted) and enable encryption with a cross-account KMS if they agree.

samir: Proposed small test plan for parity: run 1k canonical prompts through CompetitorX and Redwood shim, measure: top-1 token diffs, response-length variance, and a simple lexical similarity score (ngram overlap). Flag any outputs with >15% divergence for manual review. Also test stream reassembly (latency spikes).

trevor: Legal asked about a contract clause for model-output parity and liability — flagged as a potential blocker. We'll need simple language in SOW about output deltas and roll-back/rollback period.

evan: Also flag billing anomaly: if token counts diverge, we can offer a 30-day billing reconciliation for POC customers.

deploy-bot: staging-ip: 3.120.45.78 provisioned in eu-west-1 for greystone-poc (expires in 7 days).

maya: OK — action items: Samir to prototype shim (1 day), Rachel to enable compat header and confirm eu-west staging (2 days), Evan to send POC pricing email, Trevor to get legal SOW language, Sec to push security questionnaire. Handoff meeting Thu 10am to sync. :thumbsup: 

rachel: One more: if they rely on the CompetitorX `session_state` semantics for partial-rollforward, we should add a small migration guide snippet. Example config to wire KMS for private: 

```bash
redwood config set kms_key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
redwood deploy --env staging --region eu-west-1 --compat competitorx-v1
```

maya: Thanks everyone — will send meeting invite and the customer-facing short bullet summary now.
